SKETCH PHOTOS: "BIG DAVE'S PAR" + the two-photo strokes meme
=============================================================
Make these in ONE ChatGPT conversation so the two characters stay the same
in every picture. Paste the CHARACTERS and STYLE block first, then ask for
each photo one at a time ("Photo 1: ..."). If a face drifts, say "same Big
Dave as photo 1" and regenerate.

Save them with these exact names and send them to Claude.

CHARACTERS (fictional, not based on any real person)
- Big Dave: a cheerful, broad, fifty-something British club golfer, ruddy
  cheeks, short greying hair, neat grey beard, navy quarter-zip golf top,
  beige trousers, white cap. Confident, oblivious, loves his gadgets.
- Phil (his mate): a lean fifty-something British golfer, clean-shaven,
  dark flat cap, olive-green gilet over a white polo. Dry, deadpan, says
  little, eyebrows do the talking.

STYLE (every photo)
Bright, natural, realistic photo, UK parkland golf course in autumn,
soft late-afternoon light, shallow depth of field, shot on a phone-style
camera at chest height, portrait 1024x1536. The main action sits in the
middle of the frame with empty space at the top and bottom (text goes
there). NO words, letters, numbers, logos or brand names anywhere in the
picture: plain unbranded clubs, bags, balls, clothes and caps.

PART 1: THE SKETCH (9 photos)
seq-dave-01-driver.jpg   Big Dave on the tee, mid-swing with a driver, big
                         follow-through, face hopeful, ball flying off to
                         the right into the trees.
seq-dave-02-rough.jpg    Big Dave hacking out of deep, long rough with a
                         fairway wood, grass and leaves flying.
seq-dave-03-tree.jpg     Big Dave crouched behind a large oak tree, punching
                         a low iron shot out sideways, tongue out in
                         concentration.
seq-dave-04-bunker.jpg   Big Dave in a greenside bunker, sand exploding up
                         around him from a wedge shot.
seq-dave-05-putt.jpg     Big Dave on the green watching a long putt slide
                         past the hole, wincing, body leaning like he can
                         steer it.
seq-dave-06-tapin.jpg    Big Dave tapping the ball into the hole from six
                         inches with his putter, relieved.
seq-dave-07-proud.jpg    Big Dave on the green, beaming, proudly holding up
                         four fingers towards the camera.
seq-dave-08-mate.jpg     Close-up of Phil, deadpan, one eyebrow raised,
                         looking straight at the camera, unimpressed.
seq-dave-09-abacus.jpg   Phil calmly holding out a small wooden abacus
                         (plain, no markings) to Big Dave, who looks
                         offended. Both on the green.

PART 2: THE TWO-PHOTO STROKES MEME (2 photos)
meme-counting.jpg        Big Dave walking off a green, counting on his
                         fingers with an innocent, slightly shifty look,
                         clearly "rounding down".
meme-mate-really.jpg     Phil beside him, side-eye, mouth tight, a look
                         that says "only four, really?".

When they arrive, Claude compresses them, tags them in the photo library
and the content engine can then post the sketch and the meme by itself.
